priorityList: Cast Arcane Intellect and prepare Glacial Spike or Frostbolt before entering combat.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities when casting Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost, or while the target has the Freezing debuff.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active, but only if Thermal Void is NOT currently active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate Fingers of Frost and Icicles.
Cast Glacial Spike whenever you reach 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Flurry when charges are available or off cooldown.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
If movement is required, use Blink or Shimmer to maintain uptime.
Use Ice Lance or Blizzard (if Freezing Rain is active) as mobile fillers if you must move and cannot Blink.
Use Ice Nova or Cone of Cold as emergency fillers while moving if talented into Cone of Frost.
